Build's clean now, exit code 0. Two real bugs from the bundler bump, both in how it reshaped the options it hands to modules:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now passes `{ retryCount }`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it was throwing. Added an `undefined` → `false` case to match the old default behavior.

The rest of the ~950 lines were just deprecation/dedupe noise from the version bump, not build-breaking.
